annotations.title: SBA 7(a) loan payment with upfront guaranty fee

description: Estimate the monthly payment, total interest and SBA upfront guaranty fee on a 7(a) loan. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

amount.description: Loan amount before any financed fee (US dollars). The gross 7(a) loan amount approved.

base.description: Base rate (your figure). Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. The base rate your lender uses, such as the Prime rate on your note date.

feePaid.description: How is the upfront fee paid?. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for how is the upfront fee paid?. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: financed = Added to the loan balance; cash = Paid separately at closing.

feeRate.description: Upfront guaranty fee rate on the guaranteed portion (illustrative, enter your tier). Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. The 3.5% example is illustrative and is not the rate for the example loan size. Enter the rate for your loan size and maturity from the SBA FY2027 7(a) fee information notice, or from your lender; enter 0 if your loan qualifies for a waiver.

feeRateAbove.description: Fee rate on the guaranteed portion above that amount (illustrative, enter your tier). Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Illustrative example; use the rate in the current SBA fee notice.

guarLarge.description: SBA guaranty for loans above $150,000. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Most 7(a) programs; SBA Express is 50%. Change it if your program differs. Official reference value 75% from SBA, 7(a) loan program terms, conditions and eligibility, effective current program terms, page viewed 2026-11-09. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

guarSmall.description: SBA guaranty for loans of $150,000 or less. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Most 7(a) programs; SBA Express is 50%. Change it if your program differs. Official reference value 85% from SBA, 7(a) loan program terms, conditions and eligibility, effective current program terms, page viewed 2026-11-09. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

months.description: Loan term (months). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for loan term. Unknown is not the same as zero.

spread.description: Lender spread over the base rate (your figure). Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. The spread in your loan offer. SBA sets maximum spreads; your lender confirms them.

tierAt.description: Guaranteed portion where a higher fee rate starts (your figure; 0 if none) (US dollars). If the fee notice charges a higher rate on the guaranteed portion above a set amount, enter that amount. The example is illustrative.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_sba_7_a_loan_payment_with_upfront_guaranty_fee

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.
